record.question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding a Government servant marrying a person who is not an Indian national?
options: A Government servant is not allowed to marry a foreign national while in service.
Prior permission from the Government must invariably be obtained before marrying a foreign national.
The Government servant must intimate the Government about such marriage.
A Government servant may marry a citizen of a Commonwealth country without prior permission.
